name: Mobile Banking App — SIMULATED current/observed state (Phase 7 drift-detection demo fixture, diverges from architecture-hardened.json on purpose)
_notes: This is a hand-authored SIMULATED snapshot for Phase 7's drift detector demo, not a real cloud read-back (no cloud account exists in this build environment — see drift.py's module docstring and docs/drift-detection.md). It represents 'what a live API read-back might show' some time after architecture-hardened.json was the reviewed baseline, with seven deliberate, realistic deltas for agent/drift.py's 8 rules to catch:
4) account-service's identity binding broadened from a resource-scoped custom role to Owner/subscription (rule_identity_binding_drift, CRITICAL).
5) The api-gateway -> account-service flow's authenticated flag flipped true -> false (rule_flow_authentication_drift, MEDIUM — account-service is 'high', not 'critical', sensitivity).
6) A new asset, debug-endpoint, appears with no baseline counterpart (rule_asset_added, HIGH — it's internet-facing).

7) notification-service is gone entirely — removed from assets, trust_boundaries, its one flow, and its identity binding (rule_asset_removed, MEDIUM). This is also the fixture's proof that 'no error means no drift' would be wrong here: a diff that only walked current's keys would silently miss this asset's disappearance.
rule_waf_drift does NOT fire here on purpose: api-gateway.waf_enabled was already false in the baseline (RR-05, a known pre-existing gap, not something that can 'drift' further).
